settings.hp_tuning_note: LOCO uses default hyperparameters. With only 7 training colors per fold, nested HP tuning would be unreliable.

HybridMLP.rationale: MLPRegressor to 6 channels + FE template matching. Two hidden layers, moderate L2.

HybridSVR.rationale: MultiOutput SVR to 6 channels + FE template matching. RBF kernel, auto-scaled gamma.

MLP.rationale: Single hidden layer; strong L2 to prevent overfitting with n=42.

SVM.rationale: Default C=1; conservative gamma for fMRI dimensionality.

ForwardEncoding.description: Brouwer & Heeger 2009 forward encoding model. 6 idealized color channels, analytical solution.

HybridMLP.description: Stage 1: MLPRegressor maps voxels to 6 channel activations. Stage 2: FE template matching selects best hue (0-359°). Reverses standard FE→MLP hybrid: nonlinear encoding + linear decoding.

HybridSVR.description: Stage 1: MultiOutput SVR maps voxels to 6 channel activations. Stage 2: FE template matching selects best hue (0-359°). SVR variant of the degree-based hybrid model.

MLP.description: Multi-Layer Perceptron with ReLU activation, early stopping, and L2 regularization.

SVM.description: Support Vector Machine with RBF kernel. Non-linear decision boundaries in voxel space.
